{{Quote|Circlings are the Queen's advisers and upper-tier breeders. They're the most intelligent Quesoth, but they deal in words and thoughts, not actions.|Stromma Council Liaison Nyama|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Circling of the Red''' was a caste of the [[Quesoth]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that advised the [[Queen of the Red]], the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]], and [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] Quesoth for their [[Queen/Legends|Queen]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
